create_transform_hwctochw: create a transform that converts image tensors from HWC to CHW format with batch support
create_transform_chwtohwc: create a transform that converts image tensors from CHW to HWC format with batch support
create_transform_gaussiannoise: create a transform that adds Gaussian noise to image tensors with configurable standard deviation and clamping
create_transform_motionblur: create a transform that applies motion blur to images using a configurable kernel size, angle, and direction
create_transform_randommotionblur: create a transform that applies random motion blur to images by sampling angle and direction per image
